status_notes: Covers the statutory and ordinance instruments administered by BSI (BSIG, BSI-KritisV) and a regulatory cross-reference node for BSI C5 (whose control criteria live under secid:control/bsi.bund.de/c5).
official_name: Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik
notes: German federal cybersecurity authority. Administers the BSI Act (BSIG) and Critical Infrastructure Ordinance (BSI-KritisV). Note: BSI's technical control catalogues and attestation frameworks (IT-Grundschutz, C5, AIC4, A5, TR series) are catalogued under secid:control/bsi.bund.de; German federal statutes are also indexed by statutory citation under secid:regulation/gesetze-im-internet.de.

match_nodes.description: BSIG — Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI Act)

data.official_name: Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI-Gesetz — BSIG)
data.description: German federal statute establishing the mandate, powers, critical-infrastructure security obligations (§ 8a/8b), and federal cloud/IT security standards authority of the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI).
data.notes: Status: In force (enacted 14 August 2009, BGBl. I S. 2821; amended by IT-Sicherheitsgesetz 1.0 and 2.0; verified as of 2026-11-05).

match_nodes.description: BSI-KritisV — Verordnung zur Bestimmung Kritischer Infrastrukturen nach dem BSI-Gesetz (BSI Critical Infrastructure Ordinance)

data.official_name: Verordnung zur Bestimmung Kritischer Infrastrukturen nach dem BSI-Gesetz (BSI-Kritisverordnung — BSI-KritisV)
data.description: Ordinance under § 10(1) BSIG defining sector thresholds and covered facilities across energy, water, food, IT/telecommunications, health, finance/insurance, transport, and municipal waste management.
data.notes: Status: In force (enacted 22 April 2016, BGBl. I S. 958;verified as of 2026-11-05).

match_nodes.description: BSI C5 — Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue (regulatory mandates and cross-reference to secid:control/bsi.bund.de/c5)

data.official_name: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue (C5) — Statutory and Regulatory Mandates
data.description: Regulatory entry for BSI C5 cloud security attestation mandates in German law (including federal procurement minimum criteria under BSIG and healthcare cloud data processing under § 393 SGB V).
data.notes: Status: In force (mandatory for statutory health-insurance cloud processing under § 393 SGB V since 2024-07-01; C5:2026 edition published 2026-04-07; verified as of 2026-11-05). Cross-reference: C5 itself is an attestation control catalogue — resolve individual domains and criteria under secid:control/bsi.bund.de/c5 (e.g. secid:control/bsi.bund.de/c5@2026#OIS-01). For the statutory healthcare mandate see secid:regulation/gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb-v#§393.
